# Health & Hygiene Report 0.1.8

## Updates

- Prevents a successful update from being rolled back only because the computer already had data requiring recovery review before the update.
- Compares startup data integrity with the validated pre-update backup so unchanged existing issues do not fail the new version's startup health check.
- Continues to roll back automatically if the new version introduces additional authoritative-data integrity issues.

Existing project data is not overwritten or automatically restored by this update.
